name: Dot & Key Vitamin C + E Super Bright Sunscreen 80gm SPF50 PA+++
description:
Dot & Key Vitamin C + E Super Bright Sunscreen SPF50 PA+++ – 80gm

Description:
A lightweight, non-sticky sunscreen that protects, brightens, and energizes your skin with SPF50 PA+++ broad-spectrum defense. Enriched with Triple Vitamin C, Vitamin E, and Sicilian Blood Orange, it fights dullness, reduces pigmentation, boosts collagen, and prevents tanning—all while leaving no white cast.

Key Features:

2-in-1 Protection + Glow: Shields against UVA, UVB, and blue light while enhancing radiance

Brightening Formula: Triple Vitamin C & Sicilian Blood Orange target dullness and uneven skin tone

Skin-Friendly: Fragrance-free, non-comedogenic, paraben-free, cruelty-free

Invisible Finish: Water-light texture absorbs instantly without greasiness

For All Skin Types: Suitable for normal, dry, oily, combination, and sensitive skin

Benefits:

Activates Vitamin D receptors for sun-beneficial effects

Prevents early signs of aging with antioxidant protection

Keeps skin even-toned, smooth, and hydrated

Net Weight: 80gm
Made For: Indoor & outdoor use
